title: Playing and tuning the guitar
summary: He played guitar a while but his fingers got too soft after the service.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: What about guitar? What was the first thing you ever learned on guitar?

Well, I played a good while, okay. Mm-hmm. But after, after I came with the service, I didn't really get trombone, I didn't play good too. But after, I started making my fingers so, I didn't worry with it anymore. That's right. I can play a little right now, but I just started to see if I play a little right now, it makes my fingers so. I can barely touch the string, my fingers too soft. But I can, I can tune enough. I can tune the Spanish, I can tune the natural pitch. I can tune it anywhere I want. Mm-hmm.
Mm-hmm. You don't remember the first thing you started on guitar?
